pages.text: 早上，咘咘坐在小椅子上穿鞋子，穿了好几次都穿不上，鞋带还缠在了一起。她的小嘴嘟起来，脚跺了一下，眉毛也皱起来了。妈妈走过来说：“鞋子不听话，是有点生气，对不对？早上第一件不顺心的事，就这样来了。”
pages.text_en: In the morning, Bubu sat on her little chair to put on her shoes, but try as she might they would not go on, and the laces got tangled together. Her little mouth pouted, her foot stamped, and her eyebrows frowned. Mummy came over. "The shoes will not listen. That feels a bit angry, right? The first unhappy thing of the morning has come just like that."

pages.text: 下午，咘咘在客厅里搭了一座高高的积木塔。NOMI 在旁边递积木，NONO 站在积木边数数：“一、二、三。”塔越搭越高，咘咘踮着脚，小心地放上最后一块，眼睛都不敢眨一下。
pages.text_en: In the afternoon, Bubu built a tall block tower in the living room. NOMI passed her blocks beside her, and NONO stood by the blocks counting, "One, two, three." The tower grew taller and taller. Bubu stood on tiptoe and carefully placed the last block, hardly daring to blink.

pages.text: 可是，塔晃了一下，哗啦一声全倒了，积木滚得到处都是，有的还滚到了沙发底下。咘咘的胸口紧紧的，脸热热的，手紧紧握着。她大声说：“我不要玩了！”声音里全是生气。
pages.text_en: But the tower wobbled and crashed down with a clatter, blocks rolling everywhere, some even under the sofa. Bubu's chest felt tight, her face felt hot, and her hands clenched. She shouted, "I don't want to play anymore!" Her voice was full of anger.

pages.text: 晚上，妈妈切了一块香香的蛋糕给咘咘。咘咘刚拿到手，还没来得及吃一口，蛋糕啪嗒一下掉到了地上，奶油沾在了地板上。她愣住了，眼睛越睁越大，眼泪一下子涌出来，心里像又下了一场暴雨。
pages.text_en: At night, Mummy cut a fragrant piece of cake for Bubu. Just as Bubu took it, before she could take a bite, the cake plopped onto the floor, cream smearing on the floorboards. She froze, her eyes widening, tears rushing out. In her heart, another rainstorm began.

pages.text: 咘咘哭着跑去找妈妈：“妈妈抱抱！”可是妈妈正在厨房忙着，手上都是水和泡沫，转过头说：“等妈妈一下，妈妈现在抱不了。”咘咘听了哭得更大声了，觉得今天所有的不顺心一下子全涌上来了。
pages.text_en: Crying, Bubu ran to Mummy. "Mummy, hug me!" But Mummy was busy in the kitchen, her hands covered in water and suds, and she turned and said, "Wait a moment, Mummy cannot hug you right now." Hearing that, Bubu cried even louder, feeling as if all of today's unhappy things had rushed up at once.

pages.text: NOMI、NONO 和 Coco 没有走开，他们安静地陪在咘咘身边，谁也没有大声说话。妈妈忙完了，擦干手，蹲下来紧紧抱住咘咘：“哭是可以的，我在这里。想要的事情没达成，是很生气，对不对？妈妈都明白。”
pages.text_en: NOMI, NONO and Coco did not walk away. They stayed quietly beside Bubu, and none of them spoke loudly. When Mummy finished, she dried her hands, crouched down and hugged Bubu tightly. "Crying is okay. I am here. When what you want does not happen, it feels very angry, right? Mummy understands it all."

pages.text: 咘咘吸了一下鼻子，靠在妈妈怀里，把生气的原因一件一件说出来了：“我很生气，因为鞋子穿不上，塔倒了，蛋糕掉了，还不能马上抱抱。”说完这些，她觉得胸口好像松了一点，不像刚才那么紧了。
pages.text_en: Bubu sniffed, leaning in Mummy's arms, and said each angry reason, one by one: "I am angry, because my shoes would not go on, my tower fell, my cake dropped, and I could not get a hug at once." After saying them, her chest felt a little looser, not as tight as before.

pages.text: 妈妈说：“说出来了，真好。”咘咘按了一下自己的手掌，小声说：“暂停一下。”然后她闻一闻花，再慢慢把气吹出来，像吹生日蜡烛一样，一下，两下，呼吸慢慢变长了，肩膀也松下来了。
pages.text_en: "Saying it out loud is so good," Mummy said. Bubu pressed her own palm and said softly, "Pause for a moment." Then she smelled a flower and blew out slowly, like blowing out birthday candles, once, twice. Her breathing grew longer, and her shoulders relaxed.

pages.text: 咘咘的呼吸慢下来了，胸口也不那么紧了，脸上的热也退了一点。她小声说：“我还想再搭一次塔，这次搭得慢一点。蛋糕掉了，妈妈可以再切一块吗？这次我一定拿稳一点。”
pages.text_en: Bubu's breathing slowed down, her chest did not feel so tight, and the heat left her face a little. She said softly, "I want to build the tower again, more slowly this time. The cake dropped. Mummy, can you cut another piece? This time I will definitely hold it steady."

pages.text: 妈妈切了一块蛋糕，咘咘用手小心捧着，慢慢吃。吃完了，她又开始搭塔：NOMI 递积木，NONO 数数，Coco 说：“Slowly, slowly！慢慢来！”塔又立起来了，虽然没有刚才那么高，但很稳。
pages.text_en: Mummy cut a small piece of cake, and Bubu held it carefully in both hands, eating it slowly, bite by bite. When she finished, she started building the tower again: NOMI passed the blocks, NONO counted, and Coco said, "Slowly, slowly!" The tower stood up again. It was not as tall as before, but it was steady.

pages.text: 咘咘看着新塔，忽然想起以前摔倒了自己爬起来的事，笑着说：“摔倒了可以爬起来，塔倒了也可以再搭，蛋糕掉了也可以再切一块。”妈妈点点头：“生气的时候，先停住，再说出来，再试一次，就有办法了。”
pages.text_en: Looking at the new tower, Bubu suddenly remembered getting up by herself after falling, and smiled. "When I fall, I can get up. When a tower falls, I can build it again. When a cake drops, we can cut another piece." Mummy nodded. "When you are angry, pause first, say it out loud, then try again, and there will be a way."

pages.text: 咘咘知道，生气还会来，想要的事情还会不成，就像天气还会变一样。没关系，下一次，她可以更早停住、说出来，再慢慢想办法，不用等到哭得很大声才停下来。
pages.text_en: Bubu knew anger would come again, and wanted things would sometimes not happen, just as the weather keeps changing. That was okay. Next time, she could pause earlier, say it out loud, and then slowly think of a way, without waiting until she was crying loudly to stop.
